resize_sample_with_aspect_ratio: use the Resize class to resize image samples while keeping aspect ratio and constraining dimensions
normalize_image_with_mean_std: use the NormalizeImage class to normalize an image sample by subtracting mean and dividing by std
prepare_sample_for_network_input: use PrepareForNet to transpose and cast image, mask, disparity, and depth arrays for network input
apply_min_size_to_sample: use apply_min_size to resize a sample dict so its disparity meets a minimum height and width
constrain_dimension_to_multiple_of: use Resize.constrain_to_multiple_of to snap a dimension value to the nearest multiple of a given number
